editorial.blurb: Pilsen Yards brings warmth and thoughtful hospitality to a chic neighborhood spot where standout dishes like queso fundido with shrimp and chorizo shine alongside playful ceviches and handmade tortillas.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pina colada ceviche with banana chips and the queso fundido with shrimp and chorizo—both are consistent standouts. Come early on Friday nights (before 7pm) to avoid waits, and ask for extra smoky salsa since it pairs perfectly with their cocktails.
